subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw keep compact home-path display by default, switch user-facing agent paths to full absolute display, or add an explicit display preference?
rationale: Current code intentionally shortens home-contained paths, and changing that default or adding a setting affects UX policy and config-surface discipline rather than a narrow broken contract.

options.title: Keep Compact Default
options.body: Preserve current compact display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

options.title: Use Full Absolute Display
options.body: Change shared display helpers and prompt guidance so user-visible file references render as full absolute paths by default.

options.title: Add Display Preference
options.body: Introduce a documented opt-in display preference for users who want full absolute paths while keeping current defaults unchanged.

recommendation.title: Keep Compact Default
recommendation.body: Preserve current compact display and treat only malformed or non-copy-pasteable shortening as bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the central shortening behavior and has the strongest history signal for the current display policy surface.
